articles.title: UK crypto advocates launch campaign against banks blocking exchange transfers
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK says banks are restricting access to regulated exchanges even as policymakers seek to position the country as a hub for digital asset innovation.

articles.title: Pending Bank of Japan rate decision may impact Bitcoin price: Should traders prepare?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s average price response to Bank of Japan rate hikes was a 22.5% sell-off. Will BOJ’s upcoming policy decision trigger another BTC price crash?

articles.title: AI deepfake election ad in Minnesota raises transparency concerns
articles.snippet: A deepfake campaign attack ad in the US state of Minnesota has raised questions around the ethics of using AI in political ads and the regulations surround AI use.

articles.title: Chainalysis, South Korean police link up to fight crypto crime
articles.snippet: South Korea's national police has been battling crypto-enabled crimes from DPRK-state level threats to scams targeting retail investors.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Paradigm urge revision of GENIUS money-laundering rule
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid Policy Center and Paradigm say the Treasury’s money-laundering rules for the GENIUS Act are too onerous for stablecoin issuers.
